projects.title: Project-Timeline
projects.tagline: A fast-paced first-person roguelike in space.
projects.description: This is a first-person roguelike shooter developed in Unreal Engine using both Blueprints and C++. The goal of the project was to create a fast-paced, responsive shooter featuring challenging enemy AI and a wide variety of weapons. Players navigate through procedurally generated levels while fighting waves of enemies.Through this project, I learned how to design effective AI behaviors using behavior trees and blackboards, as well as how to implement a dynamic weapon and damage system. I also gained experience in creating diverse boss encounters. Overall, this project strengthened my skills in both Blueprints and C++, and deepened my understanding of level design and game balance.

projects.title: CryoSite
projects.description: This multiplayer shooter was developed during the final four weeks of my school year as a capstone project. The game is set in a science-fiction environment inside a research facility where experiments on alien creatures went wrong, causing the facility’s robots to go rogue. The player’s mission is to eliminate the remnants of these failed experiments and regain control of the facility.Through this project, I gained valuable experience in developing VR multiplayer gameplay, including the challenges of synchronization, performance, and player interaction in virtual reality. For networking, we used Mirror, which significantly deepened my understanding of multiplayer systems and networked game development.
